contract.attachment: already provisioned matching session descriptor, original-byte version and separate intentional native file grant; metadata-only event links through bound route
contract.backend_capacity_note: account/source backend limits independently enforced; per-spool cap is not a capacity promise
contract.default: new caller provider run creates a new logical journal; resume/retry retains it; stable IDs are application-owned
contract.intent: original event, request identity and first run/label intent persisted before effects; accepted route persisted before event send
contract.key_replacement: v2 pending actor-bound requests fail closed on key rotation; no automatic repack/rebind/new request IDs
contract.legacy: v1 private spool schema/identity and legacy emitted route/frame behavior unchanged; existing v1 binding cannot silently migrate
contract.read_authority: separate current project read grant; capture key does not grant project reads or Blob bytes
contract.routing: strict source/agent/run/logical journal/exact canonical same-origin events path; explicit mixed-run/agent batches refuse before effects
contract.source_vs_namespace: physical source project from immutable capture token and Root3 namespace from discovery are pinned separately
